title: Retention (32 days kept) and the 30-day total
policy: P16: hours older than 32 days are dropped with their dedupe keys; the 30-day total starts at local midnight 29 days before today.
derivation: The 30 days start Feb 9 00:00 PST = 08:00Z; retention starts 32 x 24 h before now = Feb 6 19:00Z. 07:59Z Feb 9 (1): kept, before the 30 days. 08:00Z Feb 9 (2): in the 30 days. 18:59Z Feb 6 (4): dropped. 19:00Z Feb 6 (8): kept, before the 30 days. Month 2, week 0, today 0; Feb 9 = 2.
